thesis: Capacity-led and closed to small cheques. The Reserve Capacity Mechanism pays for seven hours and capacity is about three-quarters of revenue, the best value per MW on the platform. A fund gets in only behind a strategic sponsor, once Capacity Credits are assigned; build seven hours, because the eighth is capex the market does not pay for.
以容量收入为主，小额出资者难以进入。备用容量机制为七小时付费，容量收入约占总收入的四分之三，每MW价值为本平台最高。基金只能在容量信用分配之后跟随战略投资者进入；建七小时，因为第八小时是市场不付费的资本开支。

reason: First of fifteen markets on hold IRR, 19.8%.
持有期IRR为19.8%，在十五个市场中排第一。
assetReturn.author: analyst

reason: Capacity revenue is about 77% of revenue, but its price is set again each year. The market rules guarantee only a floor at half the benchmark price, which secures about 39% of expected revenue for the long term.
容量收入约占总收入的77%，但其价格每年重新确定。市场规则只保证基准价一半的保底，据此长期锁定的约为预期收入的39%。
revenueCertainty.author: analyst

reason: At least 3.7% of project cost before the investment decision, most of it security posted before capacity is certain.
最终投资决策前的风险资本至少为项目投资的3.7%，其中大部分是容量尚未确定时即须提交的保证金。
capitalAtRisk.author: analyst

reason: Process, gating rules and fees are published; timeframes are indicative.
流程、准入规则与费用均已公布；时限仅供参考。
approvalTransparency.author: analyst

reason: About 55 months at the midpoint of the pathway stages, with an annual capacity cycle on the path. A rough reading, not yet a critical-path calculation.
按现有路径各阶段中点粗略估算约55个月，且路径上有年度容量周期。此为粗略判读，尚非关键路径计算。
timeToRevenue.author: analyst

reason: Network access quantities cap export until transmission relief expected at the end of 2029.
在预计2029年底投运的输电加强工程之前，网络接入量限制外送。
gridScarcity.author: analyst

foreignEntry.author: analyst
reason: A generation station of 30 MW or more connected to a wholesale electricity market is a critical electricity asset, so starting or buying a direct interest in one needs foreign investment approval whatever its value. The statutory decision period has not been confirmed.
接入电力批发市场、装机30MW及以上的发电设施属于关键电力资产，因此无论金额大小，新设或取得其直接权益均须获得外资审批。法定审批期限尚未核实。
The capacity mechanism has changed more than once in five years; existing Capacity Credits have been honoured.
容量机制五年内不止一次调整；已分配的容量信用均得到履行。
policyStability.author: analyst

reason: Large-load growth is held only as an illustrative watchlist, with no signed figure.
大负荷增长仅以示意性观察名单记录，没有已签约的数字。
demandGrowth.author: analyst

text: About three-quarters of revenue comes from the capacity mechanism, with a floor at half the benchmark price: the most secured revenue of the four markets.
约四分之三的收入来自容量机制，并有基准价一半的保底：在四个市场中锁定收入最高。
The one investor that can carry security of about USD 16m and a project of about USD 430m.
唯一有能力承担约1600万美元保证金和约4.3亿美元项目的投资者。
Network access is capped until 2029, so a position secured now is protected.
网络接入在2029年前受限，现在锁定的位置因此受到保护。

despite: A seven-hour project of this size puts a great deal into one asset and one capacity cycle, and a missed cycle costs a year.
如此规模的七小时项目把大量资本押在单一资产和单一容量周期上，错过一个周期就是一年。
strategic.author: analyst

text: Buy in once Capacity Credits are assigned and the secured revenue is certain.
待容量信用分配、锁定收入明确之后再入股。
The reference project is larger than its cheque, so the only route is a share behind a strategic.
参考项目规模超出其单笔出资上限，唯一途径是跟随战略投资者持有部分股权。

despite: A minority holder behind a strategic controls neither the timing nor the exit, and few assets have traded here.
跟在战略投资者之后的小股东既不能决定时点，也不能主导退出，而这里成交的资产很少。
infraFund.author: analyst

text: The reference project costs about USD 430m, nearly three times its largest cheque.
参考项目投资约4.3亿美元，接近其最大单笔出资的三倍。
Security of about USD 16m is posted before any revenue.
在产生任何收入之前须提交约1600万美元的保证金。

despite: The most secured revenue of any market here, and a co-investment behind a strategic remains open.
锁定收入为各市场之最，且跟随战略投资者跟投的途径依然开放。
foreignFirstTimer.author: analyst

text: Security of at least USD 16m before revenue is several times what it will risk on one project.
产生收入前至少1600万美元的保证金，是其单个项目愿担风险资本的数倍。
More than four years to first revenue, behind an annual capacity cycle.
受年度容量周期所限，首笔收入需四年以上。

despite: Scarce access makes a consented, connected megawatt valuable to exactly the buyers who can afford this market.
接入容量稀缺，使得已获许可、已并网的每一兆瓦对有实力进入该市场的买方格外有价值。
developer.author: analyst

2027年周期容量信用分配及网络接入量通知
New network access arrangement takes effect, with its contributions policy
新的电网接入安排及其出资政策生效

source.publisher: Economic Regulation Authority — access arrangement AA5 (2022 to 2027)

label: Benchmark capacity price determined for the 2029-30 Capacity Year
2029-30容量年度基准容量价格裁定
Regulator's review of the benchmark technology behind the capacity price
监管机构对容量价格所依据的基准技术进行复审
Capacity Credits assigned for the 2028-29 Capacity Year
2028-29容量年度的容量信用分配
Clean Energy Link — East expected operational
清洁能源联络线东段预计投运
Trailing-year WEM wholesale spread falls a fifth below its level when asset return was graded
西澳电力市场近一年批发价差较资产回报评分时下降五分之一

basis: 56.31 AUD/MWh was the mean daily spread over the 353 complete days to 2026-10-09, in the snapshot fetched on 2026-10-10, the day the grade was set. 20% is the move at which the platform treats drift in merchant revenue as material whatever the model says. 56.31 × 0.80 = 45.05.
56.31澳元/MWh是截至2026-10-09的353个完整交易日的日均价差，取自2026-10-10（评分当日）抓取的快照。20%是本平台认定商业收入偏离无论模型结果如何都属重大的幅度。56.31 × 0.80 = 45.05。

to: The trailing-year wholesale spread is more than a fifth below its level when the grade was set.
近一年批发价差已比评分时低五分之一以上。

note: The trailing-year WEM wholesale spread has fallen more than a fifth below its level when asset return was graded. The grade stays where the engine's ranking puts it, because the merchant assumption behind that ranking has not been revised; the trend now says the observable half of it is weakening.
西澳电力市场近一年批发价差已比资产回报评分时低五分之一以上。评分仍维持比较引擎排名所对应的档位，因为排名背后的商业收入假设尚未修订；趋势一栏则表明，其中可观测的部分正在走弱。

label: Reserve Capacity Mechanism · 8h · co-investment
备用容量机制 · 8小时 · 跟投
why: The mechanism prices a six-hour battery and the seventh hour defends the credit. On the supplier-quoted DC block the eighth now pays for itself: eight hours is the engine’s best design, worth about 6% more per MW than seven, though its hold IRR is lower, 18.1% against 19.8%.
该机制按六小时电池定价，第七小时用于守住容量信用。按供应商报价的直流电池舱计算，第八小时已能自负成本：八小时是引擎的最佳设计，每MW价值比七小时高约6%，但持有期IRR较低，为18.1%对19.8%。

text: Line up a minority stake behind a strategic sponsor now; commit once Capacity Credits for 2028-29 are assigned.
现在就物色跟随战略投资者的少数股权机会；待2028-29容量年度的容量信用分配后再出资。
